description:
Delete a graph artifact tag from a graph, the same write that `rover graph-artifact untag` performs.
The tag and its full history are removed, and any router that fetches by that tag can no longer resolve it.
The artifact itself stays.
Tags that Apollo manages, such as a variant's latest tag, cannot be deleted.
Returns the deleted tag name, or an error with a message.
Provide the graph ID and the tag name.
name: UntagGraphArtifact
